title: PredictStructure metadata.json
description: Canonical run metadata for a structure prediction. Single source of truth for tool, version, command, container, backend, params, and inputs. Both results.json (UI summary) and ro-crate-metadata.json (formal provenance) derive from this file.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the prediction began.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the prediction finished.

timestamp.description: Legacy alias for completed_at (kept for v1.0 readers).

command.description: Exact CLI argv, joinable with spaces for reproduction.

container_image.description: Container image path or digest; null for native runs.

params.description: Unified parameters used for the prediction.

inputs.description: Descriptors for every user-supplied input. File-backed entities have source/staged/checksum; inline entities (CCD/SMILES) have value.

source.description: Original location the user supplied (workspace URL, local path); null for inline-uploaded text inputs.

staged.description: POSIX-relative path inside output_dir where the audit copy lives (e.g. inputs/demo.fasta).

format.description: fasta / a3m / sto / pqt / ccd / smiles / boltz-yaml

value.description: Inline value (CCD code, SMILES). Mutually exclusive with file fields.
